allow_large: The owner allowed release bumps to go over the fix limit on 2026-09-27 (version, pin, CI header and version tests)
done_when: Forge's version is 1.0.2 in src/forge/__init__.py (release tag v1.0.2), this repo's forge.toml pins v1.0.2, and every test that checks the version expects 1.0.2

findings.body: The two new tests repeat the CLI-version and repository-pin assertions already present in `tests/test_fix_forge_v1_release.py:9–11`, which this branch updates to v1.0.2. They exercise the same entry point and configuration with identical expectations, adding another Git-backed fixture invocation and hard-coded version locations without detecting an additional failure. Remove the duplicate tests and retain the updated existing release test as the primary proof.
findings.title: Simpler: duplicate release tests → existing release test
